features: Explicit AsyncResource construction and nextTick scheduling share one per-VM ID allocator. Trigger relationships come from the active tracked execution scope or explicit constructor option; getters no longer return constant zero for these resources.

runInAsyncScope establishes actual executing resource/ID/trigger state and delivers before/after around the callback, restoring execution and AsyncLocalStorage after exceptions. Construction delivers init; explicit destruction schedules destroy. Collection registration carries ID state without retaining the resource, and explicit destruction cancels later implicit collection notification.

TickObject construction/execution/completion deliver init/before/after/destroy and preserve nested trigger relationships. Hook registration uses independent wrappers and snapshot dispatch; enable/disable is idempotent. Node reference and native controls verify real resource/scoped/tick behavior.
limitations: Promises, timers and native IO/worker producers are not connected to ID and lifecycle propagation. Execution APIs are complete only inside tracked explicit-resource and TickObject boundaries; other native callbacks and promise continuations remain incomplete. #877 stays open.

Collection-driven cleanup is implemented but not behaviorally verified in this batch. Full hook mutation/fatal-error/teardown/platform and native producer behavior remain open. Repeated explicit emitDestroy calls preserve Node repeated-notification behavior; the initial contrary reference expectation remains retained.

Fourteen original files retain 75 passes, nine process checks, zero failures/skips/TODOs and 40 filtered cases. Assertions/snapshots and pin hashes are unchanged. Earlier #874/#872 remain open and were not rerun.

Pre-build test disk refusal, cache cleanup and Node control correction are retained. Pickier retains seven existing builtin diagnostics and four warnings; the baseline builtin has eight matching diagnostics before the small const cleanup. The changed runtime scope does not establish a clean whole-repository lint result.

Corpus integration #876, performance #869/#873, HTTPS receiver/lifecycle #875/#532 and context #871/#856 remain open. Excluded constructor/Deno regressions were not rerun. Full Bun suite and Release/ASAN/all-platform verification remain open under #66.
